decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the independently requested hero title, layout, copy style, selling-point emphasis, and removal of obsolete hero copy. The book cover's new placement and cropping rules belong to the source Requirement and require no additional hero-state change.
Changing the book cover's landing-page placement and crop does not change FAQ content, and the current FAQ prize wording already describes a $500 giveaway every 100 sales.
The source changes the landing-page cover presentation and hero-area wording, not the independently scoped About page content.
Moving and cropping the book cover does not alter the live next-draw counter's value, meaning, or accuracy requirement.
The source concerns the landing-page cover and hero presentation and does not direct a change to the Mission page.
The cover-display decision does not affect wallet provisioning, wallet assets, purchase confirmation, reward access, or cashout guidance.
The source does not change automatic prize transfer, payout destination, or winner-notification channels.
The landing-page cover placement and cropping change has no effect on ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, transfer, or expiration semantics.
The message reiterates the existing one-affiliate-per-100-sales-block marketing description but does not change the current winner-selection method, eligibility, weighting, or randomness provider.
The book cover's landing-page presentation is independent of badge definitions, milestone awards, storage, icons, and display effects.
The source does not change the email provider, transactional email contents, read CTA, or reward-notification behavior.
Cropping or relocating the landing-page book cover does not affect NFT metadata fields for ticket counters, badges, or referral codes.
